brief.headline: Fifth night of Black Sea port strikes; Crimea blackouts
brief.lead: The monitored channels overwhelmingly amplified a sustained Russian air campaign against Ukraine's Black Sea ports, claiming grain export capacity cut by a third, while conceding rare bad news as Ukrainian strikes blacked out Kerch and hit Crimean water supply.

developments.title: Channels tout multi-day port strike campaign at Odesa, Chornomorsk
developments.body: Nine-plus channels claimed Russian strikes for a fifth consecutive night destroyed fuel infrastructure, drone-assembly plants and up to four vessels (WarGonzo cites 12 cargo ships over four days) at Odesa, Chornomorsk and Mykolaiv. All claims are channel/MoD-aligned and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Claimed one-third cut to Ukraine's grain export capacity
developments.body: Poddubny, Kotsnews and NgP raZVedka claim the strikes reduced Ukraine's Black Sea grain export capacity by roughly 30 percent; Kotsnews claims over 15 ships hit in a week. Framed as economic warfare; figures are unverified.

developments.title: Ukrainian strikes black out Kerch, hit Crimean water and navy ship
developments.body: In rare negative coverage, Two Majors and Rybar reported Ukrainian forces damaged the border ship Izumrud at Gelendzhik and caused a complete blackout in Kerch, with water supply suspended across multiple Crimean cities. This drove the sharp mood swing on the topic.

developments.title: FSB claims wave of foiled sabotage plots across six regions
developments.body: Rybar, Two Majors and Poddubny amplified FSB claims of prevented sabotage and terror attacks on defense plants and energy/oil facilities in six regions, including a detained saboteur in Tyumen and an FPV plot near Moscow, all attributed to Ukrainian intelligence. Unconfirmed FSB-sourced.

developments.title: Frontline advances claimed near Slavyansk-Kramatorsk and Sumy
developments.body: Rybar and Sladkov+ claimed Russian gains east of the Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration and near Dobropillia, plus the North grouping advancing on the Sumy direction. Poddubny highlighted evacuations from Konstantinovka. Tactical claims unverified.

developments.title: Ukrainian defense minister resignation, EU drone-production deal amplified
developments.body: WarGonzo flagged Ukraine's defense minister confirming resignation after six months over failed NATO reforms; multiple channels covered EU-Ukraine joint drone-production platforms (€2B plus €10B credit) and EU welfare curbs pressuring military-age men to return.

narrative_watch.title: Port strikes framed as legitimate economic warfare
narrative_watch.body: Channels increasingly cast the maritime campaign as a justified strike on Ukraine's economy and grain exports, with Starshe Eddy explicitly deeming collateral damage to 'neutral Romania' acceptable.

narrative_watch.title: West arming Ukraine despite Trump 'peace' promises
narrative_watch.body: Rybar frames continued Patriot supplies, EU industrial deals and a ten-nation air-defense coalition as proof Western commitments to end the war are hollow.

narrative_watch.title: EU 'trapping' refugees for mobilization
narrative_watch.body: Multiple channels push a narrative that EU welfare restrictions from 2027 are designed to coerce Ukrainian military-age men into returning for conscription.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant across 19 posts celebrating fifth-night port campaign and claimed one-third grain export cut.
Net sentiment jumped 78 points but remains mixed; damage to Crimea and Kerch blackout admitted alongside claimed Zaporizhzhia counter-strikes.
Consistently upbeat; claimed advances near Slavyansk-Kramatorsk, Sumy and Konstantinovka evacuations.
Sharply negative, down 36 points, dominated by anxiety over EU-Ukraine drone deals, Patriots and rearmament.
Split; FSB counter-sabotage 'wins' offset by sanctions hitting bank accounts in Central Asia and migrant tracking plans.
Isolated but pointed: Two Majors notes campaign banners angering frontline residents facing power cuts and fuel shortages.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine strikes on Russia mood up 78 points
flag_texts.body: Net sentiment rose to +11 as channels balanced admitted damage — Kerch blackout, Crimean water cuts, the damaged Izumrud — against upbeat claims of destroyed Ukrainian depots and naval drones on the Zaporizhzhia direction.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO mood down 36 points to -55
flag_texts.body: Sentiment deteriorated sharply amid a cluster of Western-support stories: EU-Ukraine joint drone production (€2B + €10B credit), continued Patriot supplies, a ten-nation air-defense coalition and Poland receiving US bridgelayers.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation rumours and Putin criticism stayed quiet
flag_texts.body: No posts on Russian mobilisation rumours or direct criticism of Putin; the single 'criticism' item targeted regional authorities over campaign banners amid power and fuel shortages, not the leadership.
